title: Participant Roster Rules for SafeStep Program Administrators
content:
# Participant Roster Rules — SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program

## 1. Who maintains the roster, and its size

The customer's program administrator adds and removes participants. The roster never exceeds the tier's largest roster size. The roster size on a given date is the number of distinct employees, by employee number, whose most recent roster entry on that date is an addition rather than a removal.

## 2. Waiting period after hire

An employee is added only when the date of addition is no earlier than the tier's new-hire waiting period in calendar days after the employee's hire date. Count calendar days starting the day after the hire date; an addition on the last waiting day is allowed.

- **Clock start:** the employee's hire date, as stated by the customer for that employee number.
- **Counting:** the day after the hire date is day 1; days are calendar days, not business days or full 24-hour periods.
- **Comparison:** the date of addition must be no earlier than the last day of the waiting period; that last day itself qualifies.
- **Length:** the tier's new-hire waiting period in calendar days.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, on a tier with a 90-day waiting period)

| Date of addition | Counted day | Addition allowed? |
|---|---|---|
| The 89th calendar day after the hire date | Day 89 | No — earlier than the waiting period allows |
| The 90th calendar day after the hire date | Day 90, the last waiting day | Yes |
| The 91st calendar day after the hire date | Day 91 | Yes |

On a tier whose waiting period is 0 calendar days, an addition on the hire date itself is no earlier than 0 days after the hire date and is allowed by this rule.

## 3. Allowance for a participant added during the year

A participant added after the allowance year started receives the share of each annual allowance given by the tier's new-hire proration rate for the quarter of the allowance year in which the participant is added, rounded half up to the cent. The share is applied to each annual allowance separately, and each result is rounded half up to the cent.

Additions take effect within the tier's participant activation lead time in business days.

### Worked figures (hypothetical allowances and rates)

- Annual allowance 100.00, rate for the quarter of addition 75 percent: 100.00 multiplied by 75 percent gives 75.00.
- Annual allowance 10.10, rate 25 percent: 10.10 multiplied by 25 percent gives 2.525, rounded half up to the cent: 2.53.

## 4. Removal

A removed participant's unused allowance is forfeited on the removal date where the tier provides for forfeiture on removal.
